Water availability and restrictions in {{data.riverCatchmentData[data.sid].properties.WB_NAME}}

Some areas are more water stressed than others. We class water bodies as 'mildly', 'moderately' or 'highly stressed'.

{% if data.sid == "1" %}
{{data.riverCatchmentData[data.sid].properties.WB_NAME}} is a mildly water stressed area.
{% else %}
{{data.riverCatchmentData[data.sid].properties.WB_NAME}} is a moderately water stressed area.
{% endif %}

How water stressed your local area is depends on how much water is already licenced and whether areas nearby need protection.

In highly stressed areas there is less water available for abstraction, especially in times of drought. In these areas there are strict restrictions on how much water you can take and when you are allowed to abstract. You can learn more below.
